chapter: Building the band in New York
title: The band's feat of memorizing ensemble parts
summary: Basie marvels at how the horn players memorized backgrounds and riffs without written music; he and the rhythm section only remembered chords. Some pieces were created in recording sessions.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
